The '''Hrill system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Yminis sector/Legends|Yminis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] containing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hrill]].
